nodes.name: alembic.ini
nodes.summary: Alembic configuration file pointing migrations to the backend/alembic script directory, leaving the SQLAlchemy connection URL blank for runtime injection, and configuring root/sqlalchemy/alembic loggers.

nodes.name: pytest.ini
nodes.summary: Pytest configuration that registers the custom 'eval' marker for slow golden-set evaluation tests and excludes them from default test runs via addopts.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned Python dependency manifest for the FastAPI backend, covering the web/task-queue stack (fastapi, uvicorn, celery, redis), the database layer (sqlalchemy, psycopg2, alembic, pgvector), the LangChain/LangGraph agentic RAG stack plus OpenAI-compatible client and evaluation tooling (ragas, datasets), and JWT/bcrypt authentication (PyJWT, passlib, bcrypt pinned to 4.0.x to avoid a passlib compatibility warning).
nodes.languageNotes: bcrypt is deliberately pinned below 4.1 to avoid a passlib<->bcrypt attribute-compatibility warning at import time, per the inline comment.
